text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r a-s-s-e-m-b-l-e-d the p-e-r-s-o-n-a b-u-i-l-d, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-h-a-r-a-c-t-e-r s-k-e-t-c-h, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-g-e-e-m-e-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
2) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-l-e-a-s-e-d the t-r-u-s-t b-u-i-l-d m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-h-a-t l-o-g a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-a-c-t c-h-e-c-k v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n.
3) the a-c-t-o-r f-i-l-e-d the e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y p-a-y-m-e-n-t r-e-q-u-e-s-t, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a w-i-r-e i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n.
4) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d the m-o-n-e-y m-u-l-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a p-a-y-m-e-n-t r-o-u-t-e r-e-c-o-r-d, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the k-n-o-w-y-o-u-r-c-u-s-t-o-m-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) the a-c-t-o-r s-i-l-e-n-c-e-d the c-o-m-p-a-r-i-s-o-n a-n-d r-e-p-o-r-t, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a g-u-i-d-a-n-c-e n-o-t-e, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t r-e-p-o-r-t l-o-g.
